## Epic plan review: PASS, signed. All 5 dropped findings checked against the tree; 2 were right.

Recording here rather than editing the description, because the attestation is fresh and none of these is blocking.

**DROP2 (G6, veto low-validity) — RIGHT about the defect, wrong about the direction.** AC3 says the consolidation is 'Checked by the consolidation story's grep counts and the **two** test-pinned ADR bodies staying green.' Exactly **one** ADR body in the 20-ADR consolidation set is test-pinned, not two: docs/adr/0095-dc-segmenting-wiki-renderer.md, read by tests/unit/reconciler/test_wiki_render.py:338. Method: resolved each of the 20 numbers to its exact filename via git ls-files, then searched every tracked tests/**/*.py for that exact path. The finding guessed 0095 was a third beyond two others and called AC3 an undercount; it is an overcount. Two near-misses explain where 'two' came from — tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:34 names 'docs/adr/0092-docs-only-verify.md', which is NOT a tracked file (the real 0092 is 0092-bridge-primary-vocabulary-compatibility-adapters.md, and there are no duplicate ADR numbers in the tree), and several of the 20 are named in test comments without their bodies being read. No action needed on the implementing story: 8257-3a28's Testing already names exactly pytest tests/unit/reconciler/test_wiki_render.py::test_adr_0095_records_the_required_sections, which is the one real pin. The epic's AC3 count is prose-only and is not unmeetable — the single pinned body staying green satisfies it.

**DROP3 (G4, veto low-validity) — RIGHT, and it had a concrete consequence that is now fixed.** The finding said children c159, 8257 and 6acd overlap on ADRs 0029, 0031, 0083, 0085, 0092 with no stated edit ordering. Checked: 0031 and 0085 are edited by BOTH 8257 (S3, which rewrites the status line and inserts an '> **Archived (2026-09-07).**' banner in all 20 originals) and 6acd (S4, which moves operator procedures out of them). Because a banner is inserted above the body, every line below it shifts — and 6acd's procedure table cites exact ranges in those two files (0031 :158-168, 0085 :58-71 and :73-79) measured against the pre-S3 tree. Under the epic's own S2 -> S3 -> S4 order those citations would have been stale against the tree 6acd actually edits. 6acd has been amended to anchor those 3 ranges on their section headings and to re-measure as its first implementation step; its other 7 ADRs are outside S3's set and are unaffected. Re-measuring also turned up an unrelated defect in the same row: the cited 0031 range :158-168 runs 3 lines past the section's end and swallows the '## Lease self-healing (C2 — extends this module)' heading at :167 — deleting it would have decapitated the next section. Corrected to :158-165. 0085's two ranges re-measured as correct exactly as written.

**DROP1 (G6, veto absence-refuted) — not substantiated.** The claim is that docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md says its in-repo copy exists to make the evidence 'durable in-repo' beyond ticket comments, so the plan owes a positive rationale for ticket comments now sufficing. The relocation story 2a3d-9d00 already carries a binding post-verify-then-delete ordering rule and an enumeration of all 5 target tickets, recorded on it after its own review. The rationale gap is a prose preference, not a correctness defect.

**DROP4 (ISF) and DROP5 (ISF) — not substantiated as stated.** DROP4 asks why the runbook-procedure move is nine ADRs rather than ten; 6acd's table enumerates its ADRs explicitly (0012, 0031, 0048, 0059, 0079, 0085, 0105, 0109, 0113), so the set is stated even though the delta from an earlier intent is not. DROP5 posits a '[non-codebase] spelling' drift distinct from the '[operator-attested]' token; no second drift item is visible in the tree.

Running tally for the drop-verification practice: 9 dropped findings have now been checked across 4 tickets, and 4 were correct. Dropped findings remain worth checking individually; they are not uniformly wrong, and they are not uniformly right either.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
`docs/` carries five dated evidence and analysis files (1,430 lines) that are the durable copy of closed ticket trails, two 13-line "moved" stubs kept only for links that exist solely in `docs/README.md`, and six citations of a design document (`docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md`) that never existed in git history. Six ADRs carry stale or unmarked status (0010, 0013, 0029, 0057, 0083, 0092) while two (0042, 0090) already show the banner form to mirror. Twenty ADRs describe the reconciler subsystem with overrides among them (0055 amends 0083; 0092's adapters paragraph was overridden by ticket 82bb-439b-1c42-4abd; 0031 and 0107 carry landed transitions), so a reader cannot find the current decision without reading all twenty. Nine ADRs embed operator procedures that `infra/runbooks/` already holds in fuller form, and four docs teach removed or renamed surfaces (`edit_ticket(tags=…)`, `[operator-attested]`, moved module paths). The operator approved the hygiene pass (2026-09-06); two items in the brief were rejected by the research and are recorded as decisions: `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` is KEPT (it is the undated process contract that `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py:5` names), and ADR 0029 is NOT superseded (ADRs 0103 and 0107 consume its arbitration unchanged), so it gets a "context landed" banner. The evidence-record targets, exact banner texts, the 0121 section outline, and the per-ADR runbook moves are fixed on origin/main 083620b08116 in this epic's first comment. ADR number 0121 is claimed by this epic for the consolidated reconciler record. The original plan reserved 0119 and assumed the CLI epic would hold 0117 and the MCP epic 0118. Both assumptions are now false: the MCP epic landed ADR 0119 (MCP surface derived from the library facade, change 3051) and the CLI epic landed ADR 0120 (CLI verb consolidation), so 0119 and 0120 are taken and 0121 is the next free number.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The five evidence files are posted verbatim as comments on their originating tickets and deleted with the two stubs; the phantom design-doc citations owned here are rewritten; the docs index gate is green. Checked by the relocation story's `diff` against each posted comment and `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`.
- [x] The six ADRs carry the exact banner or status text, and 0092 carries its amendment section; the ADR numbering and index gates are green. Checked by the banner story's `sed`/`grep` assertions.
- [x] ADR 0121 exists with one section per surviving reconciler decision (20 `from ADR 00xx` headings, at least three "supersedes" notes), and the 20 originals are marked Archived with bodies untouched. Checked by the consolidation story's grep counts and the two test-pinned ADR bodies staying green.
- [x] Each of the nine runbook-shaped ADRs points at a runbook section that now holds its procedure, including two new runbooks. Checked by the runbook story's `grep -c 'infra/runbooks/'` per ADR and the link resolver.
- [x] `docs/ticket-model.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/migrations.md`, and the `composer_edit.py` comment describe the live surfaces. Checked by the drift story's greps.
- [x] `make verify` exits 0 after each story.

## Child decomposition
- S1 evidence records to tickets, delete the stubs, fix phantom citations: criterion 1; depends on the eval-harness epic's relocation of `docs/experiments/`.
- S2 ADR banners and the 0092 amendment: criterion 2; independent.
- S3 consolidate the reconciler ADRs into ADR 0121: criterion 3; depends on S2, on the CLI and MCP ADR stories, which landed as ADR 0119 (MCP surface) and ADR 0120 (CLI verbs), not the 0117/0118 this plan assumed, and on the reconciler epic's package move so 0121 cites final paths.
- S4 procedures to runbooks: criterion 4; depends on S3.
- S5 doc drift fixes: criterion 5; independent.
